response.overview: Mark 'Sparky' Hughes was one of the most exciting strikers in Europe whose spectacular volleyed goals became his stock in trade. This video tells the remarkable story of the great Welsh forward showing many of his magical goals, including his brace in the European Cup Winners Cup Final in 1991. Football fans everywhere appreciated how good an attacker he was - pure class. The video was released in 1991.
response.title: Sparky! - The Mark Hughes Story
